headline: The Dolphins had the ball. The Chiefs had the score.

storyline.lede: The Miami night was a reminder dressed up as a result.
body: Kelce finished the night, not because Kansas City consistently got off the field.

lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City won 24-10 at Hard Rock Stadium.

analysis.body: Walker still got the carry volume, but 70 yards is 3.9 a pop. He mostly was. One interception kept it honest. Two field goals (37 and 34) were the tax for drives that got close and stalled.

whatWorked: Walker still getting 18 carries — the feature-back declaration survived a 3.9-yard night

currentState.lede: The standings will not punish them for winning ugly.

workOn.title: Finish in the red zone
workOn.body: Two field goals (37 and 34) in a game you otherwise controlled on the scoreboard is how 14-point wins start feeling like 4-point wins.

gamePlan.lede: Take the Miami tape to Allegiant.

keys.title: Cash touchdowns
keys.body: Two Miami field goals kept the Dolphins in earshot until Kelce ended it.

matchups.note: Talent edge is real; two Miami field goals are the warning.

xsandos.title: Mesh vs. Man
xsandos.coaching: The Miami night was won on timing, not hero balls.

strategies: Use mesh in the red zone; two Miami field goals are not an acceptable West-road finish.
